notes: The draft misclassified this whole screen's writes as reads: apiPost(path, body) is a 2-argument helper (no literal 'method:' key at the call site, and this screen calls no /api/flows/... route), so neither of the bootstrapper's two mutating-detection heuristics (POSTPUT regex, flow presence) ever fired -- every matched field landed in 'reads' by default. Corrected by hand: every apiPost() call site and its body object read directly, each field verified against the live bundle's fields catalog. /api/auth/create-user is a bespoke identity-pack admin endpoint outside the invocations catalog (same as login.html/usuarios-roles.html's identity fields), so its body fields are not represented here. Dropped the draft's 'identity::Role.name'/'workspace::Menu.label'/'identity::User.username'/'identity::User.displayName' shell.js and create-user-body false positives.
